decision.observation: A new entrant wearing a dark hat and reddish coat has reached the booth; the shutter is still opening and no documents are visible.
decision.hypothesis: Waiting will let the shutter finish opening and allow the entrant to present papers without another click reversing it.
decision.memory: Only Arstotzkan citizens with unexpired passports may enter. Avoid repeated shutter clicks during animation. After stamping, return the passport directly and confirm it disappears.
